entities.summary: Javid Chalabiyev is an amateur boxer from Azerbaijan who competes in the −56 kg bantamweight division. He won the 2013 World Boxing Championship title and competed at the 2016 Summer Olympics, where he was eliminated in the first bout. He competed at the 2020 Summer Olympics where he was eliminated in the round of 16.
